The later displayed inequality (pd/2+1)/(d_vis+2)<=p/2+1/d_vis also fails on this tuple: its sides are 257/3 and 5/4. Thus the stated fixed-stack estimate cannot justify (C1.25), leaving the clean row10 and averaged bounds unsupported as written. This is a variable-substitution defect in the proof, not a counterexample to the target risk bounds."
